'''Hunet L'Beck''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bimm (disambiguation)|Bimm]] [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrat]] who served the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of [[Bimmisaari/Legends|Bimmisaari]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], he invited [[Ula Vii]] to dinner in order to learn more about the background of [[Lema Xandret]] and [[Cinzia Xandret]]. L'Beck told him that the the Senate Office of Bimmisaari had received an offer from the Hutts, which would be auctioned on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] of the NaviComputer and an artifact of the wrecked ''[[Cinzia]]''.
